description:
Analysis extent for Flood, South Sudan, 24 April 2022 (FL20220424SSD): 10,645 features merged from 388 source layers. Layers whose names mark the area UNOSAT analysed, or parts of it with no usable imagery (analysis extent, area of interest, cloud obstruction, no-data, image footprint). The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Satellite detected water extents between 01 and 05 March 2023 over South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-01-and-05-march-2023-over-south-sudan)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 03 and 08 August 2022 over South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-03-and-08-august-2022-over-south-sudan)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 04 and 08 October 2022 over South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-04-and-08-october-2022-over-south-sudan)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 06 and 10 May 2023 over South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-06-and-10-may-2023-over-south-sudan)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 10 and 14 June 2023 over South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-10-and-14-june-2023-over-south-sudan)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 10 and 14 November 2022 over South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-10-and-14-november-2022-over-south-sudan)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 10 and 14 September 2022 over South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-10-and-14-september-2022-over-south-sudan)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 11 and 15 August 2023 over South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-11-and-15-august-2023-over-south-sudan)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 14 and 18 May 2022 over South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-14-and-18-may-2022-over-south-sudan)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 17 and 21 January 2023 over South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-17-and-21-january-2023-over-south-sudan)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 18 and 22 October 2022 over South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-18-and-22-october-2022-over-south-sudan)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 20 and 24 April 2022 over South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-20-and-24-april-2022-over-south-sudan)
- and 3 more; the event's [catalog page](../catalog.json) lists them all.

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = WorldView-1; 2 = WorldView-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = WorldView-3; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT-4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 27 = ASAR IMM; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleiades; 36 = DMC; 37 = RISAT-1; 38 = RISAT-2; 39 = RESOURCESAT-1; 40 = Landsat-8; 41 = SPOT-6; 42 = Sentinel-1; 43 = Kompsat-2; 44 = Sentinel-2; 45 = Sentinel-3; 46 = Kompsat-3; 47 = Deimos-2; 48 = TripleSat; 49 = PlanetLabs; 50 = RapidEye; 51 = WorldView-4; 52 = SPOT-7; 53 = VIIRS-NOAA; 999 = Combination of Sensors. The decoded text is in `SensorID_label`.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS global identifier of the feature.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 11 = EB; 18 = TH; 22 = WP; 33 = LB; 44 = JL; 45 = MD; 54 = HP; 55 = VG; 57 = PG; 66 = CJ; 70 = SG; 73 = RS; 77 = LD; 88 = HK; 91 = KA; 99 = ER; 100 = KM; 111 = MBF; 121 = CN; 131 = SB; 141 = KJP; 151 = MNY; 161 = DC; 171 = SR; 181 = NL; 191 = DH; 212 = MH; 213 = JT; 214 = ES; 215 = KB; 216 = JY; 218 = PA; 219 = SS; 220 = IS; 221 = DS; 222 = CS; 1000 = Unknown. The decoded text is in `StaffID_label`.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Very High; 2 = Medium; 3 = Uncertain; 4 = To Be Evaluated. The decoded text is in `ConfidenceID_label`.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Not yet field validated; 1 = Validated (correct); 2 = Validated (not correct); 3 = Site Not Identified in Image. The decoded text is in `FieldValidation_label`.

table:columns.name: Area_km2
table:columns.description: Area in square kilometres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID_label
table:columns.description: `ConfidenceID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation_label
table:columns.description: `FieldValidation` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Shape_Leng
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: EventCod
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
